description: Create a payment (pay-in) in a LatAm country using a local payment method. Returns the payment object with a status and, for voucher/QR methods, the redirect/display data.

amount.description: Amount in the country's currency, major units (e.g. 100 = 100 BRL, not cents)

callback_url.description: Browser redirect target after REDIRECT flow completes

card.description: For DIRECT card flow only — tokenized card object. Omit for REDIRECT.

country.description: ISO-3166 alpha-2 country code (BR, MX, AR, CO, CL, PE, UY, EC, BO, CR, GT)

currency.description: ISO-4217 currency code (BRL, MXN, ARS, COP, CLP, PEN, USD, etc)

notification_url.description: Webhook URL dLocal calls on status changes

document.description: Local tax ID (CPF/CNPJ for BR, RFC for MX, DNI for AR, etc)

payment_method_flow.description: DIRECT for tokenized card; REDIRECT for hosted flow (OXXO voucher, Pix QR, PSE bank select)

payment_method_id.description: Method id from /payments-methods (e.g. CARD, PIX, OX, PSE, SPEI). Use list_payment_methods to enumerate for a country.

name: create_payment
